privacyIntro: This site collects nothing. No accounts, no analytics, no advertising cookies, no data resale.
privacyLocal: Everything stays on your device: the theme preference (localStorage), downloaded voices for synthesis (IndexedDB), and the offline cache (service worker). None of it is sent anywhere: there is no server on our side.
privacyThird: Two providers see your IP address like any web server would: GitHub Pages (site hosting) and Hugging Face (voices, audio samples, and models). Check their privacy policies for details.
privacyContact: Questions about these rules? Open an issue on the site repository.
termsIntro: PiperHub is a directory of voices for Piper TTS, with synthesis demos right in the browser.
termsVoices: Each voice belongs to its author and keeps its own license (shown on its page and repository). Check it before any use, especially commercial. When in doubt, ask the author.
termsUse: Synthesis runs entirely in your browser: entered texts never leave it. Use the site to listen, compare, and create, without harming authors or the service.
termsWarranty: Site provided as is, with no uptime or accuracy warranty. Models evolve; rendering may change between versions.
